case.summary: Customer disputes a single in-person $49 purchase that superficially fits the cardholder’s normal region and recent spending pattern, yet the transaction carries three identity mismatches that could signal misuse at the terminal or a renewed compromise. Prior confirmed fraud on this card raises concern, but the contextual behavior over the past 48 h looks routine. Given the conflicting signals—direct customer denial versus contextual normality—I assess a moderate 55 % chance this is fraud and recommend verification with the customer before any block.
